observations.title: Popocatepetl volcano (Mexico)
observations.description: The Centro Nacional de Prevención de Desastres (CENAPRED) reported that eruptive activity was low at Popocatépetl during 16-23 September. The seismic network recorded 8-120 long-period events per day, accompanied by steam-and-gas emissions; the emissions contained small amounts of ash during 20-23 September and drifted SSW and W. During 20-21 September the seismic network also detected 55 minutes of low-amplitude tremor and a 229-minute sequence of emissions. Four volcano-tectonic earthquakes were recorded during 21-22 September. According to the Washington Volcanic Ash Advisory Center (VAAC) ash plumes were visible in webcam and/or satellite images on 19 and 21 September rising 6.1-6.7 km (20,000-22,000 ft) a.s.l. (as high as 1.3 km above the summit) and drifted S. The Alert Level remained at Yellow, Phase Two (the middle level on a three-color scale) and the public was warned to stay 12 km away from the crater. Sources: Centro Nacional de Prevencion de Desastres (CENAPRED),Washington Volcanic Ash Advisory Center (VAAC)
